asset_b.pin_timing: DD-051-14 (coordinator ruling, recorded in adjudication.md section 7): the Asset B byte-digest does not exist at this freeze, because the asset is built at Spec 047's execution step 1 (Wave 3 group 1); this freeze quotes Spec 047's freeze digest 8501feabb7beee621e99ae48529e5a74c0788fb0619ac49c615912e13914cdc7 as the contract anchor and fixes the pin source as Spec 047's step-1 outcome record; gate 0.2 asserts the byte-digest at execution step 0 against that record - mismatch closes INVALID, an unfrozen or unsound asset closes NOT-RUN by dependency closure, exactly as drafted; fail-closed semantics unchanged
asset_b.pin_source_description: Spec 047's step-1 outcome record - the outcome append in Spec 047's directory that its frozen section 4.6 (the digest recorded in the step-1 outcome record, with the row count, the testable count and the per-status counts) and section 9 (the outcome append in this directory) specify
asset_b.gate_0_2: the execution exhibits the asset at its contract path, recomputes its SHA-256 over the file bytes as committed, and compares it to the digest recorded in the pin source: a mismatch closes the run as INVALID; if Spec 047's step 1 has not frozen Asset B, or the asset has been shown unsound under Spec 047 section 4.6, the run closes as NOT-RUN (dependency closure); the asset is never rebuilt, re-derived or substituted under this spec
asset_b.unsound_rule: any later change to a row's status or class makes the frozen asset unsound under Spec 047 section 4.6: the campaign cluster tripwire fires, this spec closes as not-run, and a corrected asset requires a successor spec

step0_gates.input_integrity: every section 2 input carrying a pin hashes to its freeze-record value; a mismatch stops the run as INVALID (gate 0.1)
step0_gates.asset_b_digest: gate 0.2, per the pin-timing ruling DD-051-14: INVALID on digest mismatch, NOT-RUN on an unfrozen or unsound asset
step0_gates.asset_b_form: exactly 30 rows, one per pinned gazetteer cluster, the seven contract fields, statuses and classes in the contract vocabularies; any form failure stops the run as INVALID (gate 0.3); the testable set is derived by rule
step0_gates.counting_layer_census: gate 0.4 (DD-051-13, confirmed): the Holdat layer of record is identified from the database, exported in full and pinned by SHA-256 in the step-0 record, which states the export's file form and sort order as produced; the gate re-derives the M391 per-site counts, which must reproduce the section 1 census exactly (Mohenjo-daro 75, Harappa 52, Dholavira 16, Lothal 14, Surkotada 11, Kalibangan 10, Chanhu-daro 10, Banawali 3, Rakhigarhi 2; total 193), the per-site inscription totals and the per-site mean inscription lengths; any failure closes the run as INVALID before anything is counted
step0_gates.join_census: every record of the pinned export is accounted for in exactly one of joined, non-spine site (listed with record and M391 counts) or no site value; an unplaceable record stops the run as INVALID (gate 0.5)
step0_gates.floors: gate 0.6: at least 3 testable gateway/border sites carry M391, and neither the pooled side nor the contrast side is empty in the test population; a floor failure closes the execution as INCONCLUSIVE with the classification as the finding and no share computed (DD-051-5, confirmed and consistent with Spec 047's DD-047-11: Spec 047's 12-testable-site gate governs Spec 047's test only and is not imported here)

measures.share: for each test-population site, s_i = M391 occurrences at the site divided by inscriptions at the site
measures.primary_ratio: R = the pooled class's aggregate arrow share over the contrast class's aggregate arrow share
measures.city_ratio: R_city = the gateway/border class's aggregate arrow share over the administrative class's aggregate arrow share

test.fisher_exact: computed on the pooled 2 x 2 table and reported beside the permutation result; not verdict-bearing (DD-051-11, confirmed as drafted)

class_addition.fits: per-site shares regressed on site size alone, then on size plus the pooled/contrast class, sites weighted equally (DD-051-8, confirmed)
class_addition.seed_source: DD-051-10: the seed for both permutation procedures is fixed at this freeze as 20261021

criteria.supported: R >= 1.5 and p < 0.05 and class-addition ADDS and R_city > 1.0
criteria.not_supported: R <= 1.0, or R_city <= 1.0, or the class-addition outcome is SIZE-ONLY
criteria.inconclusive: every remaining case (1.0 < R < 1.5; or R >= 1.5 with p >= 0.05; or class-addition NEITHER with R > 1.0 and R_city > 1.0)

test.non_rejection: DD-051-3 (confirmed): permutation non-rejection with R > 1.0 is INCONCLUSIVE here, diverging openly from Spec 047's partition, because D-10's text fixes NOT SUPPORTED as ratio at or below 1.0 or size alone explaining the pattern

test.sensitivities: per-class shares, the five-largest-sites description, the each-source-alone recomputations and the restated exclusion lists are reported beside the primary and never change the verdict
